name: HealthCheck
short: HTTP liveness endpoint for external monitoring
description: Exposes GET /health -> 200 {"status": "ok"} over HTTP so process managers and orchestrators (Kubernetes liveness probes, uptime checks) can confirm the bot process is alive. Dependency-free by design: it reflects only that the process is running. Binds to 127.0.0.1 by default; set the host to 0.0.0.0 for container/Kubernetes deployments.
install_msg: HealthCheck installed! It serves GET /health on 127.0.0.1:8080 by default (loopback only). For a container or Kubernetes pod, run `[p]healthcheck bind 0.0.0.0 8080` then `[p]healthcheck restart` so the probe can reach it.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store or transmit any end user data. It exposes only a static process-liveness status over HTTP.
